title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Since you're stuck here sifting through documents, I might as well help you solve a few problems around the office.

title: Talk 1
original: Hitting supply lines does a whole lot more damage than taking out people.

title: Talk 2
original: If you ask me, your office is on the bland side. Just hit me up if you ever want to mix things up a little.

title: Talk 3
original: The whole 'cozy family relationship' thing isn't for me.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I get a lot more out of talking to strangers than I do from that 'self-help' shtick.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: We define ourselves by symbols, but those symbols can be perverted. Reused. Reworked, reframed, remade. In a word, stolen. Who are you then?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I don't mind helping you run errands out of combat, but on the battlefield, I need ample room to call the shots.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: When someone can't find fault with your results and has to resort to nitpicking your attitude, that tells you everything you need to know about them.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: To call the shots, you need to prove that you've got what it takes – and you've certainly done that. So, where are you sending me next?

title: Idle
original: Your workload is clearly excessive, even by the highest standards. Take a rest.

title: Onboard
original: Codename Ela, member of Team Rainbow. Just give me my objective, then sit back and wait for the good news.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Picked up a few new tricks.

title: Promotion 1
original: A medal? Thanks. Workmanship's not bad at all, as far as decorations go.

title: Promotion 2
original: Together, we can shake the very stars from the sky.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Time to show you what I can do.

title: 3-star Result
original: I'm sorry, was I too fast for you?

title: Tap
original: Do me a favor, don't talk to me.
